name: 学期
en_sentense: This semester we have more new subjects.
zh_sentense: 这学期我们新增了几门科目。

name: 教科书
en_sentense: Keep your textbooks neat and clean.
zh_sentense: 保持教科书整齐干净。

name: 教学大纲
en_sentense: The teacher follows the syllabus to arrange lessons.
zh_sentense: 老师按照大纲安排授课内容。

name: 课程设置
en_sentense: Junior high curriculum is more complex.
zh_sentense: 初中课程体系更加复杂。

name: 地理
en_sentense: Geography helps us know the whole world.
zh_sentense: 地理帮我们认识整个世界。

name: 生物
en_sentense: We observe plant cells in biology class.
zh_sentense: 生物课上我们观察植物细胞。

name: 道德与法治
en_sentense: This subject guides us to behave properly.
zh_sentense: 这门学科引导我们规范言行。

name: 物理（预备认知）
en_sentense: We get simple physics knowledge in daily life.
zh_sentense: 我们在生活中接触简单物理知识。

name: 化学（预备认知）
en_sentense: Chemistry studies changes of different substances.
zh_sentense: 化学研究不同物质的变化。

name: 实验
en_sentense: Do science experiments carefully under teacher's guide.
zh_sentense: 在老师指导下认真做科学实验。

name: 实验室
en_sentense: No running or shouting inside the lab.
zh_sentense: 实验室内禁止奔跑喧哗。

name: 实验服
en_sentense: Put on your lab coat before starting the experiment.
zh_sentense: 开始实验前穿上实验服。

name: 物质
en_sentense: Water and air are common substances.
zh_sentense: 水和空气都是常见物质。

name: 固体
en_sentense: Stone and wood belong to solid state.
zh_sentense: 石头、木头属于固态。

name: 液体
en_sentense: Juice and oil are typical liquids.
zh_sentense: 果汁、食用油是典型液体。

name: 气体
en_sentense: Oxygen and carbon dioxide are gases.
zh_sentense: 氧气、二氧化碳属于气体。

name: 物态变化
en_sentense: Melting and freezing are state changes.
zh_sentense: 融化和凝固都属于物态变化。

name: 融化
en_sentense: Ice melts quickly at room temperature.
zh_sentense: 冰块在室温下快速融化。

name: 凝固
en_sentense: Water freezes into ice below zero degrees.
zh_sentense: 零摄氏度以下水凝固成冰。

name: 蒸发
en_sentense: Water evaporates faster with higher temperature.
zh_sentense: 温度越高，水蒸发速度越快。

name: 凝结
en_sentense: Water vapor condenses into small water drops.
zh_sentense: 水蒸气凝结成小水珠。

name: 原子
en_sentense: All matter is made up of tiny atoms.
zh_sentense: 所有物质都由微小原子构成。

name: 分子
en_sentense: Water molecule consists of hydrogen and oxygen.
zh_sentense: 水分子由氢原子和氧原子组成。

name: 元素
en_sentense: Iron and gold are different chemical elements.
zh_sentense: 铁和金是不同的化学元素。

name: 混合物
en_sentense: Air is a mixture of many kinds of gases.
zh_sentense: 空气是多种气体组成的混合物。

name: 纯净物
en_sentense: Distilled water is a pure substance.
zh_sentense: 蒸馏水属于纯净物。

name: 溶液
en_sentense: Salt dissolved in water forms salt solution.
zh_sentense: 食盐溶于水形成食盐溶液。

name: 溶剂
en_sentense: Water is the most common solvent in daily life.
zh_sentense: 水是日常生活最常用的溶剂。

name: 溶质
en_sentense: Salt acts as solute in salt water.
zh_sentense: 食盐在盐水中充当溶质。

name: 溶解
en_sentense: Sugar dissolves completely in hot water.
zh_sentense: 白糖在热水里完全溶解。

name: 过滤
en_sentense: We filter muddy water to remove sediment.
zh_sentense: 我们过滤泥水去除泥沙。

name: 滤液
en_sentense: The clear liquid collected is filtrate.
zh_sentense: 收集得到的透明液体就是滤液。

name: 滤纸
en_sentense: Fold filter paper properly before filtration.
zh_sentense: 过滤前正确折叠滤纸。

name: 烧杯
en_sentense: Pour liquid gently into the glass beaker.
zh_sentense: 缓慢把液体倒入玻璃烧杯。

name: 试管
en_sentense: Do not heat the test tube facing classmates.
zh_sentense: 加热试管时管口不要对着同学。

name: 量筒
en_sentense: Use graduated cylinder to measure fixed liquid volume.
zh_sentense: 用量筒量取固定体积液体。

name: 温度计
en_sentense: Read thermometer scale at eye level.
zh_sentense: 视线平视读取温度计刻度。

name: 托盘天平
en_sentense: Adjust balance level before weighing objects.
zh_sentense: 称量物体前调平天平。

name: 质量
en_sentense: Mass will not change with location shift.
zh_sentense: 物体质量不会随位置改变。

name: 体积
en_sentense: Volume shows how much space an object occupies.
zh_sentense: 体积表示物体占据空间大小。

name: 密度
en_sentense: Different materials have different density values.
zh_sentense: 不同材质密度数值各不相同。

name: 力
en_sentense: Force can change an object's movement state.
zh_sentense: 力可以改变物体运动状态。

name: 重力
en_sentense: Gravity pulls all objects toward the ground.
zh_sentense: 重力将所有物体拉向地面。

name: 摩擦力
en_sentense: Friction slows down sliding moving objects.
zh_sentense: 摩擦力减缓滑动物体速度。

name: 浮力
en_sentense: Buoyancy makes ships float on seawater.
zh_sentense: 浮力让轮船漂浮在海面上。

name: 速度
en_sentense: Speed equals distance divided by time.
zh_sentense: 速度等于路程除以时间。

name: 路程
en_sentense: We calculate walking distance every morning.
zh_sentense: 我们计算每天步行的路程。

name: 运动方向
en_sentense: Force has both size and direction.
zh_sentense: 力既有大小，也有方向。

name: 静止的
en_sentense: The box stays stationary on the desk.
zh_sentense: 箱子静止放在桌面上。

name: 运动
en_sentense: Wind causes the movement of leaves.
zh_sentense: 风力造成树叶运动。

name: 细胞
en_sentense: Cell is the basic unit of living organisms.
zh_sentense: 细胞是生物体基本结构单位。

name: 细胞膜
en_sentense: Cell membrane controls material entry and exit.
zh_sentense: 细胞膜控制物质进出细胞。

name: 细胞核
en_sentense: Nucleus stores genetic information of cells.
zh_sentense: 细胞核储存细胞遗传信息。

name: 细胞质
en_sentense: Many organelles distribute inside cytoplasm.
zh_sentense: 细胞质内分布多种细胞器。

name: 细胞壁
en_sentense: Only plant cells have firm cell walls.
zh_sentense: 只有植物细胞拥有坚固细胞壁。

name: 叶绿体
en_sentense: Chloroplast carries out photosynthesis for plants.
zh_sentense: 叶绿体为植物开展光合作用。

name: 光合作用
en_sentense: Plants make glucose through photosynthesis.
zh_sentense: 植物依靠光合作用制造葡萄糖。

name: 呼吸作用
en_sentense: All living cells keep respiration day and night.
zh_sentense: 活细胞昼夜持续进行呼吸作用。

name: 组织
en_sentense: Many similar cells form biological tissue.
zh_sentense: 多个同类细胞构成生物组织。

name: 器官
en_sentense: Heart and leaves are typical organs.
zh_sentense: 心脏、叶片都是典型器官。

name: 系统
en_sentense: Digestive system consists of several organs.
zh_sentense: 消化系统由多个器官组成。

name: 生物体
en_sentense: A complete human is a complex organism.
zh_sentense: 完整人体是复杂生物体。

name: 消化
en_sentense: Stomach helps digest food fully.
zh_sentense: 胃部充分消化食物。

name: 吸收
en_sentense: Small intestine absorbs nutrition into blood.
zh_sentense: 小肠把营养吸收进血液。

name: 排泄
en_sentense: Human bodies excrete waste timely every day.
zh_sentense: 人体每日及时排出代谢废物。

name: 防疫
en_sentense: We learn basic epidemic prevention knowledge at school.
zh_sentense: 我们在校学习基础防疫知识。

name: 免疫的
en_sentense: Good sleep improves immune ability.
zh_sentense: 充足睡眠提升免疫能力。

name: 病毒
en_sentense: Virus cannot reproduce independently outside cells.
zh_sentense: 病毒离开细胞无法独立繁殖。

name: 细菌
en_sentense: Some bacteria are beneficial to human intestines.
zh_sentense: 部分细菌对人体肠道有益。

name: 真菌
en_sentense: Mushroom is a large type of fungus.
zh_sentense: 蘑菇属于大型真菌。

name: 生态系统
en_sentense: A lake forms an independent small ecosystem.
zh_sentense: 一片湖泊构成独立小型生态系统。

name: 生产者
en_sentense: Green plants are primary producers in nature.
zh_sentense: 绿色植物是自然界初级生产者。

name: 消费者
en_sentense: Herbivores and carnivores are consumers.
zh_sentense: 食草、食肉动物都属于消费者。

name: 分解者
en_sentense: Fungi break down dead plants as decomposers.
zh_sentense: 真菌作为分解者降解枯死植物。

name: 食物链
en_sentense: Grass → rabbit → eagle forms a simple food chain.
zh_sentense: 草→兔子→老鹰构成简单食物链。

name: 食物网
en_sentense: Interconnected food chains build a food web.
zh_sentense: 多条互相连通的食物链组成食物网。

name: 纬度
en_sentense: Latitude lines run parallel to the equator.
zh_sentense: 纬线与赤道互相平行。

name: 经度
en_sentense: Longitude lines connect the north and south poles.
zh_sentense: 经线连接南北两极。

name: 赤道
en_sentense: The equator divides earth into north and south hemispheres.
zh_sentense: 赤道把地球划分为南北半球。

name: 半球
en_sentense: China lies in the northern and eastern hemispheres.
zh_sentense: 中国位于北半球、东半球。

name: 大洲
en_sentense: There are seven continents on planet Earth.
zh_sentense: 地球上共有七大洲。

name: 大洋
en_sentense: Four major oceans connect with each other.
zh_sentense: 四大洋彼此相互连通。

name: 高原
en_sentense: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau is world-famous.
zh_sentense: 青藏高原举世闻名。

name: 平原
en_sentense: Large plains are suitable for farming.
zh_sentense: 大片平原适宜农耕种植。

name: 山地
en_sentense: Mountains have steep slopes and high altitude.
zh_sentense: 山地坡度陡峭、海拔较高。

name: 丘陵
en_sentense: Hills have gentle slopes and low elevation.
zh_sentense: 丘陵坡度平缓、海拔低矮。

name: 盆地
en_sentense: Basins are low-lying land surrounded by hills.
zh_sentense: 盆地是四周环山的低洼地带。

name: 流域
en_sentense: The whole river basin shares the same water resource.
zh_sentense: 整个流域共享一套水资源。

name: 支流
en_sentense: Small tributaries flow into the main river.
zh_sentense: 众多小支流汇入干流。

name: 干流
en_sentense: The main stream carries larger water flow.
zh_sentense: 干流的水流量更大。

name: 入海口
en_sentense: River sediment deposits at the river estuary.
zh_sentense: 河流泥沙在入海口淤积。

name: 三角洲
en_sentense: Rich soil accumulates on river deltas.
zh_sentense: 河流三角洲淤积肥沃土壤。

name: 气候
en_sentense: Climate decides local plant and crop types.
zh_sentense: 气候决定当地植被与农作物种类。

name: 气温
en_sentense: Average temperature changes with four seasons.
zh_sentense: 平均气温随四季更替变化。

name: 降水量
en_sentense: Precipitation includes rain, snow and hail stones.
zh_sentense: 降水包含降雨、降雪、冰雹。

name: 季风
en_sentense: Summer monsoon brings abundant rainfall to eastern China.
zh_sentense: 夏季季风给我国东部带来充沛降水。

name: 人口
en_sentense: Population distribution is uneven across China.
zh_sentense: 我国人口空间分布不均衡。

name: 城市的
en_sentense: Urban areas have complete public facilities.
zh_sentense: 城市地区公共设施配套完善。

name: 乡村的
en_sentense: Rural areas rely mainly on planting and breeding.
zh_sentense: 乡村地区以种养业为主。

name: 交通运输
en_sentense: Convenient transportation boosts local economy.
zh_sentense: 便捷交通带动地方经济发展。

name: 自主学习
en_sentense: Junior high students need independent study ability.
zh_sentense: 初中生必须具备自主学习能力。

name: 预习
en_sentense: Preview new lessons before each class.
zh_sentense: 每节课课前预习新课内容。

name: 复习
en_sentense: Review knowledge points every evening on time.
zh_sentense: 每晚及时复盘当天知识点。

name: 整理笔记
en_sentense: Sort out class notes neatly every night.
zh_sentense: 每晚工整整理课堂笔记。

name: 错题本
en_sentense: Record typical mistakes in your error notebook.
zh_sentense: 把典型错题整理进错题本。

name: 归纳规律
en_sentense: Summarize problem-solving rules from exercises.
zh_sentense: 从习题里归纳解题规律。

name: 课外阅读
en_sentense: Stick to half an hour extracurricular reading daily.
zh_sentense: 坚持每日半小时课外阅读。

name: 文言文
en_sentense: We learn simple classical Chinese articles in Grade Seven.
zh_sentense: 七年级我们学习浅显文言文篇目。

name: 古诗词
en_sentense: Recite and appreciate classic ancient poetry.
zh_sentense: 背诵并赏析经典古诗词。

name: 作文提纲
en_sentense: Draw a clear outline before writing compositions.
zh_sentense: 动笔写作文前列清晰提纲。

name: 中心句
en_sentense: Each paragraph has a clear topic sentence.
zh_sentense: 每个段落设置明确中心句。

name: 过渡句
en_sentense: Use transition sentences to connect paragraphs naturally.
zh_sentense: 用过渡句自然衔接段落。

name: 定语从句
en_sentense: We start to learn simple adjective clauses.
zh_sentense: 我们开始接触简易定语从句。

name: 时态
en_sentense: Master simple present and past tenses first.
zh_sentense: 先掌握一般现在、过去时态。

name: 被动语态
en_sentense: Learn to switch active voice into passive voice.
zh_sentense: 学习主动语态改被动语态。

name: 短语
en_sentense: Memorize fixed phrases in groups efficiently.
zh_sentense: 分组高效背诵固定短语。

name: 上下文语境
en_sentense: Guess new word meaning from context.
zh_sentense: 结合上下文猜测生词含义。

name: 扫读
en_sentense: Use scan reading to find key information quickly.
zh_sentense: 扫读快速定位关键信息。

name: 略读
en_sentense: Skimming helps grasp the full article main idea.
zh_sentense: 略读把握整篇文章主旨。

name: 精读
en_sentense: Do detailed reading for comprehension questions.
zh_sentense: 做理解题需要精读原文。

name: 整数
en_sentense: Positive and negative numbers belong to integers.
zh_sentense: 正负数都属于整数。

name: 有理数
en_sentense: Integers and fractions are rational numbers.
zh_sentense: 整数和分数统称为有理数。

name: 绝对值
en_sentense: Absolute value stands for distance to origin.
zh_sentense: 绝对值代表到原点的距离。

name: 相反数
en_sentense: The opposite number of five is negative five.
zh_sentense: 5的相反数是-5。

name: 乘方指数
en_sentense: The upper small number is the exponent.
zh_sentense: 右上角小数字就是指数。

name: 单项式
en_sentense: A single number or letter is a monomial.
zh_sentense: 单独数字或字母都是单项式。

name: 多项式
en_sentense: Several monomials form a polynomial.
zh_sentense: 多个单项式相加构成多项式。

name: 同类项
en_sentense: We can combine like terms in calculation.
zh_sentense: 计算时可以合并同类项。

name: 一元一次方程
en_sentense: Linear equations have only one unknown variable.
zh_sentense: 一元一次方程仅有一个未知数。

name: 方程的解
en_sentense: Substitute the solution back to check correctness.
zh_sentense: 把解代回原式验算正误。

name: 坐标轴
en_sentense: Horizontal and vertical lines form coordinate axes.
zh_sentense: 水平线、竖直线组成坐标轴。

name: 坐标原点
en_sentense: The crossing point of two axes is the origin.
zh_sentense: 两轴交点就是坐标原点。

name: 象限
en_sentense: The plane is divided into four quadrants.
zh_sentense: 坐标平面被划分为四个象限。

name: 坐标点
en_sentense: Mark each coordinate point accurately on the graph.
zh_sentense: 在坐标系里精准标注坐标点。

name: 线段
en_sentense: A line segment has two fixed endpoints.
zh_sentense: 线段拥有两个固定端点。

name: 射线
en_sentense: A ray extends endlessly from one endpoint.
zh_sentense: 射线从一端点无限延伸。

name: 直线
en_sentense: Straight line stretches infinitely both ways.
zh_sentense: 直线向两端无限延长。

name: 角平分线
en_sentense: Angle bisector divides one angle equally into two parts.
zh_sentense: 角平分线把一个角平分成两半。

name: 垂线
en_sentense: Perpendicular lines form a right angle together.
zh_sentense: 两条垂线相交形成直角。

name: 平行线
en_sentense: Parallel lines never intersect forever.
zh_sentense: 平行线永远不会相交。

name: 内角
en_sentense: Sum of three interior angles equals 180 degrees.
zh_sentense: 三角形三内角之和等于180度。

name: 外角
en_sentense: An exterior angle equals the sum of two non-adjacent interior angles.
zh_sentense: 外角等于不相邻两个内角之和。

name: 等腰三角形
en_sentense: Two sides of isosceles triangle are equal.
zh_sentense: 等腰三角形两条边长相等。

name: 等边三角形
en_sentense: All three sides of equilateral triangle are equal.
zh_sentense: 等边三角形三边长度全部相等。

name: 直角三角形
en_sentense: Right triangle contains a ninety-degree interior angle.
zh_sentense: 直角三角形含有一个90度内角。

name: 全等三角形
en_sentense: Congruent triangles have identical shape and size.
zh_sentense: 全等三角形形状、大小完全一致。

name: 平移
en_sentense: Translation only changes position not shape or size.
zh_sentense: 平移只改变位置，形状大小不变。

name: 旋转
en_sentense: The figure rotates around a fixed central point.
zh_sentense: 图形绕固定中心点旋转。

name: 对称轴
en_sentense: Fold along axis of symmetry to get overlapping parts.
zh_sentense: 沿对称轴折叠两边完全重合。

name: 统计图
en_sentense: Statistical charts display data more intuitively.
zh_sentense: 统计图直观展示数据。

name: 抽样调查
en_sentense: We use sample survey for large group statistics.
zh_sentense: 大范围统计采用抽样调查法。

name: 总体
en_sentense: All research objects make up the population.
zh_sentense: 全部调查对象构成总体。

name: 样本
en_sentense: Extract representative samples from the whole population.
zh_sentense: 从总体抽取代表性样本。

name: 平均数
en_sentense: Calculate average score of the whole class.
zh_sentense: 计算全班平均分。

name: 中位数
en_sentense: Median divides ordered data into two equal parts.
zh_sentense: 中位数把有序数据平分为两段。

name: 众数
en_sentense: Mode is the most frequently appearing number.
zh_sentense: 众数是出现频次最高的数值。

name: 班规
en_sentense: Every student must obey unified class rules.
zh_sentense: 全体同学必须遵守统一班规。

name: 班委会
en_sentense: Class committee assists the head teacher in management.
zh_sentense: 班委会协助班主任管理班级。

name: 小组长
en_sentense: Group leader distributes group tasks reasonably.
zh_sentense: 小组长合理分配小组任务。

name: 小组合作
en_sentense: Group cooperation solves difficult tasks faster.
zh_sentense: 小组合作更快攻克难题。

name: 沟通交流
en_sentense: Communicate politely with teachers and classmates.
zh_sentense: 礼貌和老师、同学沟通交流。

name: 换位思考
en_sentense: Try to empathize with your classmates when conflicts happen.
zh_sentense: 发生矛盾时试着站在同学角度换位思考。

name: 包容体谅
en_sentense: Keep tolerance for small differences among partners.
